profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Fintech
profile.summary:
➢	12+ years lead software development experience in data protection, trading platforms development, full stack web development and mobile applications development.
➢	MS in Machine Learning from Georgia Institute of Tech
➢	12+ years excellent programming skills using OOPS, Design patterns, Data structures and algorithms and well versed in programing languages such Python/Java/C++ and JavaScript frameworks, React and jQuery.
➢	2+ years of full stack banking domain experience for Fixed income currency and Trading in Python & React
➢	Machine learning enthusiast having knowledge in Supervised and Un-supervised learning, Reinforcement learning and Natural language Processing

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and building highly scalable backend trading systems

positions.title: AVP-Data protection lead
positions.description:
Leading the Data protection efforts in Data lake specifically Hadoop using in-house custom-made solutions and third-party solutions like Integris and Protegrity 

Responsibilities
•	Leading the team in redacting the protected information using encryption and tokenization of sensitive data
•	Planning for timelines for vendor solutions and coordinating with different teams.
•	Analyzing different Machine learning solutions for the data protection.

positions.title: AVP- FICC Trading platform development
positions.description:
Fixed Income Currency and Commodities (FICC) Emerging Market business operates across the globe with onshore sales and trading operations across Latin America, CEEMA & ASIA.
The Global Emerging Markets technology group is responsible for the development and on-going support of the systems required for the smooth running of this complex global business, system ranging from pricing and execution to risk management and regulatory reporting.

Responsibilities
•	Development of python backend business logic for the Trader signoff and Reporting platform and application to manage Trading Books.
•	Working closely with developers in multiple different regions as well as business to gather requirements, feedbacks, propose solution and coordinate changes.
•	Building out service-oriented platforms as micro-services architectures
•	Design of software systems that is compatible with other applications in the bank and interfaces for upstream and downstream data through various batch jobs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Open Mobile Alliance Device Management (OMA-DM) Project builds device management application for Android devices.  This application is used to activate the device as well as to control the device from the Sprint server. Also worked on Sprint Chameleon Project brand the phone for Virtual network operators like Boost and Virgin during activating the phone during activation.

Responsibilities:
●	Leading the design, architecture and development and maintenance of an Android projects within Samsung-Sprint with hands on coding in JAVA and Android
●	Writing testable code and performing unit and integration testing using android testing frameworks like Android Instrumentation Testing and Junit, Mockito, PowerMock
●	Development of C/C++ libraries for Open Mobile Device Management. Also Worked in Tizen OS and applications for Samsung smart watches.

positions.title: Android developer
positions.description:
Development of Android SDK and Application for streaming live channels and recorded media from Motorola media hardware.
The application is used by the end user in their Android devices for watching remotely or in home.

positions.title: Senior software Engineer
positions.description: Worked for client OEMS (Sony Ericson, Sweeden, Samsung Software Operations India and Samsung Telecommunications America) in Android application development and framework modification mostly in multimedia middleware, camera, stagefright etc.
